text:
Beneath the lamps’ ethereal, pale light,
He walked the streets in the dead of night.
Each footfall echoed on stone and gray,
While ghosts of people drifted by.

No glance was cast, no word was spoken,
Their faces lost, their hearts unbroken
By the world outside, in depths they dwelled,
In private worlds, their souls were held.

Amidst the sea of urban tide,
With nowhere left for him to hide,
A profound solitude took hold,
A story of isolation told.

The animal known for its long neck is the giraffe.
